## What's new in Dropshake v1.2.7

- Added **Shortcuts…** to the menu bar. Assign global shortcuts to all ten menu commands, grouped under **Shelf** and **App**.
- **⌘E** opens the shelf by default, and custom assignments are saved between launches.
- Choosing **Shortcuts…** brings the window forward when it is behind another app.
- Added **Send Feedback…** to open the Dropshake issue tracker.

## Install

Download `Dropshake.dmg`, open it, and drag Dropshake into Applications. The universal app requires macOS 13 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
